book.name: Mɑteu
book.title: LABAARI GEA NGE MƐ MATEU U YORUA

content: Sɔm kowo be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ ɡbɑɑrɔ
Mɑ Yesu u nɛɛ, n wee ye Gusunɔn bɑndu tɑ kɑ weenɛ. Yɛnu yɛ̃ro ɡoo u yɑrɑ buru buru yellu u kɑ sɔm kowobu kɑsu bu dɑ win ɡbɑɑrɔ.
U wurɑ u bu kɔsiɑ nɡe mɛ bɑ rɑ sɔm kowo kɔsie sɔ̃ɔ teeru, mɑ u nɛɛ bu doo bu sɔmburu ko win ɡbɑɑrɔ.
Ye n kuɑ bururun kɔbɑ nɔɔbɑ nnɛ, u kpɑm yɑrɑ mɑ u ɡɑbu deemɑ bɑ sɔ̃ tɛnɡɛɔ bɑ ǹ ɡɑru mɔ̀.
U bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, bɛɛn tii i doo i sɔmburu ko nɛn ɡbɑɑrɔ. Kon bɛɛ yen ɡobi kɔsiɑ nɡe mɛ n weenɛ.
Mɑ bɑ dɑ mi. Yɛnu yɛ̃ro wi, u kpɑm yɑrɑ sɔ̃ɔ wii wɔllu, kɑ mɑɑ yokɑn kɔbɑ itɑ, mɑ u kuɑ mɛ.
Ye n dɑ kuɑ yokɑn kɔbɑ nɔɔbu, u kpɑm yɑrɑ u ɡɑbu wɑ be bɑ sɔ̃ mi. U bu bikiɑ u nɛɛ, mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ i sɔ̃ mini sɑɑ bururun di i ǹ ɡɑru mɔ̀.
Bɑ wisɑ bɑ nɛɛ, yèn sɔ̃ ɡoo kun sun sɔmburu wɛ̃. Mɑ u nɛɛ, ǹ n mɛn nɑ, i doo nɛn ɡbɑɑrɔ i sɔmburu ko bɛɛn tii.
Ye n kuɑ yokɑ yɛnu yɛ̃ro wi, u win sɔm kowobun wiruɡii sokɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ sɔm kowobu sokuo ɑ bu ben ɡobi kɔsiɑ, sɑɑ birukobun min di sere kɑ ɡbiikobun mi.
Be bɑ sɔmburu toruɑ yokɑn kɔbɑ nɔɔbu bɑ nɑ mɑ bɑ sɔ̃ɔ teerun sɔmburun ɡobi wɑ.
Ye ɡbiikoo be, bɑ nɑ, bɑ tɑmɑɑ beɡii koo kerɑwɑ mɛ. Adɑmɑ sɔ̃ɔ teerun sɔmburun ɡobiyɑ bɑ mɑɑ ben tii kɔsiɑ.
Ye bɑ ɡobi yi wɑ bɑ kɑ yɛnu yɛ̃ro wi wɔki.
Bɑ ɡeruɑ, bɑ nɛɛ, be bɑ dɑ̃kuru nɑ mi, kɔbi tiɑ tɔnɑwɑ bɑ kuɑ mɑ ɑ bu kɔsiɑ nɡe bɛsɛ be sɑ sɔmburu kuɑ bururun di kɑ sɔ̃ɔ boko.
Mɑ u ben turo wisɑ u nɛɛ, nɛn bɔrɔ, nɑ ǹ nun tɑki di. A wurɑ mɑ kɑɑ sɔ̃ɔ teerun sɔmburun ɡobi mwɑ, nɡe n ǹ mɛ.
Ǹ n mɛn nɑ, ɑ wunɛn ɡobi mɔɔ ɑ doonɑ. Nɑ̀ n kĩ n biruko wini kɔsiɑ nɡe wunɛ, mbɑ n nun wɑ.
N ǹ ye nɑ kĩ yerɑ kon kɑ nɛn ye nɑ mɔ ko? Nɡe ɑ nisinu mɔ̀wɑ yèn sɔ̃ nɑ tɔn ɡeeru kuɑ.
Mɑ Yesu nɛɛ, nɡe mɛyɑ birukobu bɑ koo ko ɡbiikobu, ɡbiikobu mɑɑ, bɑ koo ko birukobu.
Yesu u win ɡɔɔ kɑ win seebun ɡɑri mɔ̀ nɔn itɑse
Nɡe mɛ Yesu u dɔɔ Yerusɑlɛmu ɡiɑ, swɑɑɔ u win bwɑ̃ɑbu wɔkurɑ yiru ye tɔnɑ sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ,
wee, sɑ dɔɔ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ mi bɑ koo Tɔnun Bii yɑ̃ku kowo tɔnwerobu kɑ woodɑ yɛ̃robu nɔmɑ bɛriɑ. Bɑ koo nùn tɑɑrɛ wɛ̃ bu ɡo,
kpɑ bu nùn tɔn tukobu nɔmu sɔndiɑ be bɑ koo nùn yɑɑkoru ko, bu nùn sɛni so, yen biru bu nùn kpɑre dɑ̃ɑ bunɑnɑrɔ. Sɔ̃ɔ itɑse u koo mɑɑ se ɡɔrin di.
Ye Yɑkɔbu kɑ Yohɑnun mɛro u bikiɑ
Yerɑ Sebeden bibun mɛro u nɑ Yesun mi kɑ win bibu sɑnnu u yiirɑ u kɑ ɡɑ̃ɑnu kɑnɑ.
Yesu u nùn bikiɑ u nɛɛ, mbɑ ɑ kĩ. U nɛɛ, ɑ de nɛn bibu yiru yeni yu sinɑ, turo wunɛn nɔm ɡeuɔ, turo mɑɑ wunɛn nɔm dwɑrɔ sɑnɑm mɛ kɑɑ bɑndu di.
Yesu u wisɑ u nɛɛ i ǹ yɛ̃ ye i bikiɑmɔ, i ko kpĩ i wɑhɑlɑ sɔbe ye kon sɔbe? Mɑ bɑ nɛɛ, sɑ ko kpĩ.
Yesu bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, kɑ ɡeemɑ i ko wɑhɑlɑ sɔbe nɡe nɛ. Adɑmɑ n ǹ nɛn bɑɑ n kɑ ɡɔsi be bɑ koo sinɑ nɛn nɔm ɡeuɔ kɑ nɛn nɔm dwɑrɔ. Tɔn bèn sɔ̃ nɛn Bɑɑbɑ u ɑye ni sɔɔru kuɑ beyɑ bɑ koo nu wɑ.
Ye bwɑ̃ɑbu wɔku te tɑ tie tɑ ɡɑri yi nuɑ, tɑ kɑ yiru ye mɔru kuɑ.
Yerɑ Yesu bu sokɑ u nɛɛ, bɛɛn tii i yɛ̃ nɡe mɛ tɔn tukobun tem yɛ̃robu bɑ rɑ n bu dɑm dɔremɔ. Kpɑ ben wiruɡibu bɑ n bu tɑɑremɔ.
Adɑmɑ n ǹ sɑ̃ɑ mɛ bɛɛn mi. Bɛɛn ɡoo ù n kĩ u ko wiruɡii, u de u ko bɛɛn sɔmɔ.
Mɛyɑ mɑɑ bɛɛn wi u kĩ u ko ɡbiikoo u koowo bɛɛn yoo.
Nɡe mɛyɑ Tɔnun Bii kuɑ. U ǹ nɛ bu kɑ nùn sɑ̃ mɑ n kun mɔ u kɑ ɡɑbu sɑ̃, kpɑ u win wɑ̃ɑru wɛ̃ u kɑ tɔn dɑbinu yɑkiɑ.
Yesu wɔ̃kobu yiru bɛkiɑ
Sɑnɑm mɛ bɑ yɑrɑ Yerikon di, tɔn wɔru ɡunɑ Yesu swĩi.
Wɔ̃kobu yiru ɡɑbɑ sɔ̃ swɑɑ bɑɑrɔ bɑ nuɑ mɑ Yesu sɑrɔ. Yerɑ bɑ nɔɔɡiru suɑ bɑ nɛɛ, Yinni, Dɑfidin sikɑdobu, ɑ bɛsɛn wɔnwɔndu wɑɑwo.
Tɔn wɔru ɡunɑ ye, yɑ bu wɔkisimɔ bu mɑrio. Kɑ mɛ, bɑ ɡbɑ̃rɑmɔ too too, bɑ mɔ̀, Yinni, Dɑfidin sikɑdobu, ɑ bɛsɛn wɔnwɔndu wɑɑwo.
Yerɑ Yesu u yɔ̃rɑ u bu sokɑ mɑ u bu bikiɑ u nɛɛ, mbɑ i kĩ n bɛɛ kuɑ.
Bɑ nùn wisɑ bɑ nɛɛ, Yinni, sɑ kĩ bɛsɛn nɔni yi yɑm wɑwɑ.
Yesu u ben wɔnwɔndu wɑ mɑ u ben nɔni bɑbɑ. Yɑ̃ɑtem mi, tɔnu yiru ye, yɑ yɑm wɑ mɑ yɑ nùn swĩi.
